title: The site builds from one content file and runs locally
feature_label: Static site skeleton, local - PR #24 diff (not deployed)

steps.label: Run `mise trust && mise install`, then `mise run web:install`.
Run `mise run web:dev` and open http://localhost:4321; the hero and footer show.
Change the headline in `apps/web/content/en.yaml`; reload and see the hero text change.
Set a section flag to false in the content file; reload and see that section gone.
Run `mise run web:build`, then open a file in `apps/web/dist` with JavaScript off; the page still reads top to bottom.
